name: lethal-company
notes: Reference pack: BepInEx 5 on Lethal Company (Steam appid 1966720).
Deliberately small — it exists to prove the pipeline and to be copied.
Deps are resolved transitively by thunderstore-checksums; BepInEx itself is
pinned separately by loaderPackage/loaderVersion because every mod depends on
some BepInEx 5.x version and we want ONE loader, not one per dependency.
